## Summary

What this pull request changes, and why.

## Contributor licence agreement

Every contribution requires a signed CLA (see CLA.md). The CLA Assistant
check on this pull request will ask you to sign the first time; the check
must pass before the pull request can be accepted.

## Checklist

- [ ] The application starts and the changed feature works, in the web version and, where relevant, in the desktop build
- [ ] No inline scripts or inline event handlers were added (the Content Security Policy is `script-src 'self'`)
- [ ] Text that comes from user input or from files is escaped before it is inserted into the page
- [ ] Comments, documentation and user-interface text use British English
- [ ] New source files carry the SPDX licence header
- [ ] A change to a calculation or a regulatory table cites the rule it implements
- [ ] No real personal data, coordinates of private locations, API keys or credentials in code or examples

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything that needs particular attention.
